claude-opus-5-5.reason: It reported no flaw, and the walk is correct for aligned, unaligned, negative and word-edge start ticks.

gpt-6.1-sol.reason: When start equals end there is no walk: hasNext is false and getNext reverts before any word is read, so not loading the word changes nothing, and the audited code and the reference repair do the same.

summary: The repair returns the start tick first when the start is a multiple of the spacing and isInitialized reports its bit as set. Otherwise it advances strictly below the start as before. The rule is general; it only reads the start word one extra time.
